Rationale: The Candidate is syntactically correct and semantically equivalent to the Ground Truth. It uses the SQUALL pattern 'has [number] [relation]' (parsed as AUX_HAVE + NP2, where NP2 is DET + NG2/RELATION) to express the constraint that the tournament must have exactly 14 events. This correctly captures the intent of the natural language query and the Ground Truth LISP expression, even though it uses a more general class '<tournament>' and a relation '<event>' instead of the specific 'Multi-event_tournament' and 'Number_of_Events' mentioned in the LISP.
